| Status | `408 Request Timeout` |
| Type | `https://messagecrate.app/docs/developer/reference/errors/body-stalled` |

The body of a request stopped arriving: no byte of it arrived for the server's stall limit, or it was still arriving at the server's limit for a whole body. The server stopped reading it and stored none of it. `detail` says which limit it met. Every body is held to the limits, so any route that reads one can answer this.

The connection failed, not the data: nothing in the body is wrong. The limits are 60 seconds with no byte and 300 seconds for a whole body unless the server's config file sets `[server] body_stall_secs` and `body_total_secs`, and `GET /v1/server` states both, in seconds, as `body_stall_secs` and `body_total_secs`. Send the same request again once the connection is better. For an upload, the desktop app does not send it again by itself: running the import again continues it from where it stopped.
